notes.title: 🧪 BOTSU Demo Heading Back to the Lab! 🤖
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who played the BOTSU demo, embraced the chaos, and gave us all your incredible feedback! This was so much fun💥


With all your amazing feedback from this demo period and PAX East, we’re heading back to the lab for some more experimentation to see how far we can push this silly physics game!  We may be a little quiet for a while, but don’t worry, we’re cooking up some even crazier stuff just for you and we’ll be back with a bang! 👨‍🍳



In the meantime, join our Discord so you’ll always get first hand access to all the insider scoop about the future of Botsu and participate in exclusive playtests!

Be There, Be Square 🤖🧊



Oscar & Lydiah

notes.title: 🤖 BOTSU IS BACK! - Demo update & more mayhem!
notes.content:
Missed the chaos? Don’t worry, we brought it back! 
The BOTSU demo is LIVE again for the PC Gaming Show, and guess what? A brand-new trailer just dropped too! 🎉 Don’t say we don’t spoil you 😜

[previewyoutube="bp-7deYlZjc;full"][/previewyoutube]

The fun is just getting started, more chaos is coming and we want you to be a part of it! So, come and join us over in the BOTSU Discord , provide feedback to Oscar directly and share your insane plays (or epic fails) with others.

notes.title: V0.2. 9_BETA 🤖Bots ⚖️Balancing 🪲Bugs
notes.content:

New bot: Jurassic Mark - Thanks Rolo

⚖️ Balancing

🛠️ Improvements

Sumo says “Next Point Wins” and “Blue Team needs one more to win” when one or both teams are close to victory – Thanks Fox
Auto-Equip newly unlocked outfits disabled. Default is to not equip, unless you press to equip – Thanks Fox + others

Fixed Pyramids map legs stuck in the floor at round start – Thanks Riftis, Chubs + others
Fixed booster sound not looping in infinite boost matches – Thanks OverDen

notes.title: V0.1.18 🔓Unlocks! 🗳️Voting! 🥳Parties! 🌍Servers!
notes.content:
I’m really excited to share this update, as it includes many much-requested features from the community! Thanks so much to all of you for providing this feedback, and please keep messaging me about improvements and content you’d like to see. 

I’ve been working hard towards the full game's release, creating new content, including new locations, arenas, modifiers and costumes, but I thought it would be good to share the new systems with the loyal demo players! Thanks so much for the support and feedback on the demo, you are awesome! 😻 We’re nearly there…

🔓 Unlock Paths

New unlock system allows you to choose between themed unlock paths.
Choose your active unlock path and track its progress via the brand new “Unlocks” tab in pause menu at any time.
Progress through path stages by earning XP. 
Each stage of the path unlocks a new outfit part. 
Paths are unlocked by player level.
Watch your unlock path progress in the rewards screen after a match.
Many more unlock paths and outfits coming in the full game!

🗳️ Next Match Voting

You can now vote to choose your next match, after the rewards screen.
New match generation system aims to give you matches that are different to the ones you have recently played.

🥳 Parties with Friends

The new Party system lets you join your Steam friends and stay together. Find it in the “Party” tab in the pause menu.
•	Party members stay together through matches, server changes and will return to home together.
Join or invite friends via the steam overlay. Right click on the friend to join or invite.

🌍 Server Browser

New server browser kiosk next to the train lets you see and join any public matches being played, anywhere in the world.

🐞 Bug Fixes And Small Improvements

Lighting on outfit selection previews is more consistent now, across different times of day.
Fixed selection outline not showing sometimes on outfit selection grids.
Players can no longer be heard punching each other behind the rewards screen.
Your player now dances in the rewards screen at the end of the match!

notes.title: V0.1.17 🏊🛟🤿Pool Party! 🙌👏Cheering Crowds!
notes.content:
I’ve mainly been working on content for the full game, but this demo update includes a sneak peek into some of the new swimming and water mechanics that will make their way into matches for the full game. Hopefully some underwater sports, water polo and other levels coming in the future 😊

🌊 Pool Physics

🤽Brand new swimming pool in the Home area for you to mess around with!
🛟New buoyancy physics mechanics for objects floating/sinking and receiving drag in the water. Will it float?!
💦 The pool comes with a host of new water effects so you can make a splash!

🏊 Physics-Based Swimming

🏊 Swim around in 3D, on or under water, with new physics-based animations
🤿 Mix swimming with all other mechanics like grabbing, throwing, fighting and jumping

🐬 Diving Board Physics

🦘 All-new, physics-based diving boards
🤸 You can bounce, flip, grab, fall and anything else you can think of!

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦🙌👏 Stadium Crowd Excitement

The stadium crowd now goes wild for Sumo and Stockpile gameplay moments like they do for BoxBall. (they’ve finally learned the rules….)

notes.title: V0.1.16 🦖🦕 3 Dinosaur Outfits! ✨ Faster Levelling up!
notes.content:
To celebrate Steam Dinos vs Robots Fest, there’s 3 brand new outfits to unlock, to fit the Robo/Dino theme. Even the bots have dressed up! I’m really pleased with how these outfits turned out, particularly the triceratops, so I hope you have fun bashing up these dinos.

🦖🦕 Dino Outfits

🦏 Triceratops!
🦅 Pterosaur!
🐲 T-Rex!


✨🌟 Level Up XP

Reduced level 1 xp from 400 to 200
Reduced per-level xp increase from 200 to 100

notes.title: V0.1.15 - 🏪 Community Kiosk 🪧 Signs, Signs, Signs!
notes.content:
I’ve been busy building new arenas and content for the full game, but I had time to put in some improvements to the demo, too. Mostly focusing on signposting (literally!) to help players find features like matchmaking, inviting friends and joining the community. 

🏪👥 Community Kiosk

Added a “Community” kiosk with dancing Discord Wumpus to help players find and join the BOTSU Discord Community (if you’re reading this and haven’t joined yet, what are you doing??!!)
Moved Custom Match kiosk further away as it is not enabled in the demo. Community kiosk takes its place.

🎮🖼️ Controls Billboard

Added controls screen billboard to home space to help new players and show extra controls that are not in the tutorial.

🙋‍♂️🙋‍♀️ Play with Friends

“Connect” kiosk renamed to “Play with Friends”, shows how many are online, and now takes you to Steam friend invite screen.

🏪🚆Matchmaking Train Signs

Added A-board signs to tell players how to join an online match via matchmaking.
Improved position and visibility of the matchmaking train sign.
Matchmaking train sign now says “arriving” when the train is arriving, and “boarding” when it has arrived.

🖼️❤️ Wishlist Billboards

Added some billboards in the home space to encourage players to wishlist BOTSU on Steam. Thanks everyone who has wishlisted already! it helps others find the game, which really helps me out!! 🙏

💬Find out more behind the scenes on the BOTSU Discord or via social media: https://linktr.ee/botsu.game

notes.title: V0.1.14 - ⚽🥊🏠 Balancing, Sandbox, Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
⚽ Boxball

Boxball travelling explosion now destroys attached grappling hooks, so the travelling and grab times are enforced for grappling hooks.

🤼 Sumo

Increased sumo starting booster fuel from half tank to full tank.
Fixed lava disappearing sometimes for joined players.

🥊Boosting & Grabbing After Taking Hits

Boosting is now interrupted by taking hits, for 0.66s.
Boost cooldown time after taking hits reduced from 2s to 0.66s.
Grab cooldown time after taking hits reduced from 1s to 0.66s.

🏠 Home Area

Added gadgets to home playground area. Can you find all 4?
Added booster fuel to the home area.
Added shadows for lights inside the train carriage.
Train signs now say “Matchmaking” to make it clearer.
Added a train sign when leaving tutorial.
Train now comes out of a dark, dark tunnel.
Fixed some missing collision on the train carriage doors.
Upgraded beach ball.

🎬 Replays

Fixed corrupt replay recordings if joined a match (when not a host).
Fixed bug where recent replay recordings do not get cleared from disk unless opening the replay menu.

💾 Player Progress Save Backups

Fixed bug where the game cannot start if the player save data had been corrupted due to a crash.
If player save data becomes corrupt, it will now use very frequent backups, and a less frequent backup on startup to ensure that the player save data is recovered without losing a lot of progress.
Added confirmation and error messages when renaming a player profile.

notes.title: V0.1.12 🌐🔃👥 No More Interruptions!
notes.content:
This update aims to fix two main issues that previously interrupted playing with friends online, so that you can carry on punching each other, uninterrupted!

Online Multiplayer

If a host leaves, the match will continue with the same players now. There will be a host migration loading screen for a few seconds, a new host will be selected and the other players will reconnect to the same match to pick it up where it left off. 

Match and Online UI

Added a message when multiplayer connection is interrupted and attempting to reconnect
Renamed “Leave Session” to “Exit Match” on pause menu match tab
Removed “End Session” from pause menu match tab
Renamed “End Session” to “Kick All” on pause menu online tab

Changing Teams

 Fixed black screen after changing teams during instant replay

notes.title: V0.1.11 🎈📦🚀 Balloons, Boosters, Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for Botsu’s first Multiplayer Madness event and giving lots of feedback!! You’re awesome!
This update includes fixes for the main issues people found, and I’ll be working through the rest of it for new updates soon. Thanks again!

Match Generation

Balloons are much more likely to be included in matches now (25% -> 66%)
Stockpile can have boosters now (0% -> 50%)
Initial match list for new players improved to include more variation

Match Introduction UI

Instructions for game modes are much more prominent now, with larger font size and animations for emphasis

Online Multiplayer

If finding or joining a match takes too long (usually caused by host quitting as you join), a button will appear to host your own instead
Commentary text for “RCKT PETUNIA ballooned you!”, “WOBBLY MACNABB threw you!” and others working in online multiplayer matches now

Controls Settings

Enabling Gamepad 1 as Player 2 split-screen controls setting (Player 1 keyboard only) now requires changing the setting with keyboard/mouse, to prevent being locked out of Player 1’s split-screen on devices without keyboard/mouse e.g. Steam Deck.

Bug fixes

Fixed incorrect FoV tooltip
Fixed music staying muted when joining a match via steam invite

notes.title: V0.1.10 – Boxball Travel Explosion, Other Improvements
notes.content:
Boxball

To prevent the unstoppable tactic of boosting directly into the goal from afar, taking the goalie with you, the rule of “traveling” has been borrowed from basketball. In addition to the existing behaviour that makes the ball explode when held for 5 seconds to end tug-of-war stalemates and traveling, the ball now has a max carry distance of 18 metres. This means that you cannot carry the ball more than 18m, boosting or not, without it exploding. This excludes moving vertically
Fixed a bug where if a player left a match while holding the ball, it would think it was still being held, causing it to explode every 5 seconds until scored
The pitch grass is now greener

Sumo

Sumo basic map now has a white line at the edge to help you tell when you are close to the edge. The main pitch is now brown, so it looks more like a sumo ring.

Background Gaming

Audio “Focus Only” setting can be turned off to enable audio when the game is not focused, or is in the background
Gamepad Input “Focus Only” setting can be turned off to enable gamepad input when the game is not focused, or is in the background

Display Settings

Resolution and windowing mode are no longer applied every time the pause menu closes, which caused issues if you were changing the windowing mode and resolution with Alt+Tab or resizing a window
Fixed button styling on apply revert buttons

Replay Mode

Fixed not being able to return to the game after viewing a replay
Added slo-mo button controls

notes.title: V0.1.9 – Multiplayer Stability Improvements
notes.content:
Online Multiplayer

 Preventing joining hosts that have low frame-rate, which cause lag for all players

Fixes

 Fixed FPS display in graphics settings

notes.title: V0.1.8 – Online Match Flow and UI Update
notes.content:
Online Multiplayer Match Flow

Team selection is now maintained between matches
Joining a match via the train is now smoother, showing loading screen that says “Finding Matches…”
If you have joined a match and the host leaves, you will now see “Migrating host” and the match will quickly resume with you as a host, with the same mode, arena, score, time and bot players. Previously it would start a new, different match from the start
If you become disconnected from a match for any reason, your XP will be kept for you and awarded at the end of the next match you complete in that play session 
Fixed host pausing other players during multiplayer matches after disconnected from host

Sumo

When spectating after falling into lava in sumo, you can switch between the players you are spectating now with mouse buttons, keyboard arrows, keyboard W, E, controller d-pad or shoulder bumpers

Boxball

Fixed boxball cube sometimes invisible for first round of boxball match if joined another player online

UI/HUD

Gadgets on HUD now include their button icon to show you what to press
Added “XP” suffix to xp popups on HUD so the numbers are not confused with round points or match score
End of match podium screen community and wishlist buttons at bottom of the screen no longer conflict with character controls on that screen
Added “Exit to Desktop” button from settings tab of pause menu so it can be used during matches
Game now remains visible in background, when not focused, including on additional monitors
Web pages open in steam overlay browser instead of opening up a new default browser tab
Developer feedback button moved up in the menu
Reworded wishlist screen back button

Audio

 Fixed level-up screen and recovery button mash sounds being silent after first match

Known issues

Graphics settings screen FPS display does not update, so always says 60. Until this is fixed, please use Steam FPS display, or press CTRL+ALT+, (comma) to enable debug overlay

notes.title: V0.1.7 – Host Disconnect Flow Update
notes.content:
Online Multiplayer Match Flow

 When you are unexpectedly disconnected from a match (host ended it), you will immediately proceed to another match, instead of be kicked out to the home space
 When a host leaves a match to go back to the home space, the other online players will go to new matches instead of home with the host

notes.title: V0.1.6 – The Eardrum Update
notes.content:
Audio

 Added overall volume control
 Fixed some very loud sounds in rewards screen,  knock-out recovery and boxball hold beeps

Matches

 Preventing 2 matches in a row with same game mode
 New players get a set of 3 pre-defined matches before going on to generated matches
 Fixed multiple “Match Completed” and other XP awards in a row at end of match

Stockpile

 Stockpile changed from best of 5 to best of 3 so duration is more similar to other game modes

Sumo

 Fixed spectating sumo bots hugging for ages after human players are out
 “Pacifist” XP Award is now only for round survivors in Sumo, not just anyone who didn’t hit

Tutorial

 Fixed falling to infinity at the top of tutorial gadget room
 Fixed having to return to coach at end of tutorial if you run ahead
 Fixed having coach telling player to pick up boost fuel when they have already crossed

UI

 Made it easier to tell which button is hovered, especially when there are only 2 options, by making chevrons dance to the music
 Replay mode controls now include button icons and mouse keyboard version
 Fixed repeated unlocks display at level 4

notes.title: BOTSU Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Online Multiplayer
-	Play online and split-screen (at the same time!) 
-	Hop on the train to find an online game

3 Game Modes
-	BOXBALL - Get the ball in the goal!
-	SUMO SURVIVAL - Don’t fall in the lava, be the last one standing!
-	STOCKPILE - Collect boxes and steal from the other team!

5 Arenas
-	2 arenas each for Boxball and Sumo, plus one for stockpile.

10 unlockable costumes
-	Earn XP in matches and level up to find out what they are…

Tutorial
-	Coach is here to show you the ropes.

Home Area
-	Party up in the home area to join a match together, practice or just mess around.
